title: 第330章 秦夜献策稳朝局第329章 女帝新政遇阻力
lines: 女帝的新政，如同在平静的湖面投下了一块巨石，激起了千层浪。朝堂之上，反对之声，此起彼伏，一浪高过一浪。那些保守派的官员，如同被踩住了尾巴的猫，上蹿下跳，使出浑身解数，阻挠新政的实施。
女帝虽然强势，但面对这盘根错节的利益集团，也感到有些力不从心。她可以杀一个太子，可以罢黜几个贪官，但她不可能将整个朝堂的官员，都换一遍。若是逼得太急，恐怕会引发更大的动荡。
一连几天，女帝都显得有些心事重重，眉头紧锁。秦夜看在眼里，急在心里。他知道，女帝的新政，对于大炎帝国来说，是一次难得的机遇。若是错过，恐怕就再也没有机会了。
这天傍晚，秦夜主动求见女帝。在御书房中，他看到女帝正坐在书案后，面前堆满了奏章，但她却没有批阅，只是呆呆地望着窗外，不知在想些什么。
“微臣，参见陛下。”秦夜走到书案前，躬身行礼。
女帝回过神来，看到他，脸上露出一丝疲惫的笑容：“秦爱卿，你来了。坐吧。”
秦夜依言坐下，看着女帝那张明显消瘦了许多的脸庞，心中有些不是滋味。他沉吟了片刻，然后，缓缓开口道：“陛下，微臣斗胆，想为陛下，献上一策。”
“哦？”女帝眼中，闪过一丝感兴趣的光芒，“秦爱卿有何良策？快快说来！”
秦夜站起身，走到墙上挂着的那幅大炎帝国堪舆图前，指着图上标注的几个重要州县，缓缓道：“陛下，微臣以为，陛下想要推行新政，最大的阻力，并非来自于那些保守派的官员，而是来自于……他们背后所代表的利益集团！”
女帝闻言，若有所思地点了点头：“秦爱卿所言极是。那些官员，之所以拼命反对朕的新政，无非是因为新政损害了他们背后那些世家大族、豪商巨贾的利益！”
“正是！”秦夜继续道，“所以，陛下想要推行新政，就必须先打破这些利益集团的垄断！而要打破他们的垄断，就需要……扶持新的力量！”
“新的力量？”女帝眉头一挑，“秦爱卿指的是……？”
秦夜的目光，变得深邃起来，他缓缓道：“微臣指的是……寒门士子！”
“寒门士子？”女帝眼中，闪过一丝疑惑。
“不错！”秦夜点了点头，“如今朝堂之上，大部分的官员，都出身于世家大族。他们世代为官，盘根错节，早已形成了一个牢不可破的利益共同体。而寒门士子，虽然才华横溢，却因为没有背景，没有门路，而难以进入朝堂，施展抱负！”
他顿了顿，声音变得更加有力：“若是陛下能够打破常规，大力提拔那些有真才实学的寒门士子，让他们进入朝堂，与那些世家子弟，形成制衡！如此一来，那些保守派的势力，自然就会被削弱！而陛下的新政，也能够得到更多人的支持！”
女帝听完秦夜的话，眼前顿时一亮！她仿佛在黑暗中，看到了一盏明灯！
“妙计！果然是妙计！”女帝忍不住拍案叫绝，“秦爱卿，你这一策，简直是拨云见日，让朕茅塞顿开！”
她站起身，在御书房中，来回踱步，一边走，一边兴奋地说道：“朕可以开‘恩科’，扩大录取名额，专门面向那些寒门士子！朕还可以设立‘求贤馆’，广纳天下贤才！朕要让那些世家大族知道，这天下，不是他们一家一姓的天下！”
秦夜看着女帝那重新焕发出光彩的脸庞，心中也感到一阵欣慰。他知道，自己的这一策，算是说到女帝的心坎里去了。
“陛下圣明！”秦夜躬身道，“不过，微臣还有一点建议。”
“秦爱卿但说无妨！”女帝连忙道。
秦夜缓缓道：“陛下提拔寒门士子，固然是好事。但也要注意，循序渐进，不可操之过急。否则，恐怕会引起那些世家大族的激烈反弹。微臣建议，可以先从一些不那么敏感的职位开始，逐步培养寒门士子的力量。同时，也要加强对那些提拔上来的寒门士子的考察和培养，确保他们真正有才能，有品德，能够胜任其职。”
女帝听完，连连点头：“秦爱卿考虑得甚是周到！就按你说的办！”
秦夜献策，稳朝局。秦夜在女帝推行新政遭遇巨大阻力之际，适时地献上了一策——扶持寒门士子，打破世家垄断！这一策，如同一把钥匙，打开了女帝心中的枷锁，也为大炎帝国的未来，指明了一条新的道路！
content_en:
The empress's new policy was like throwing a huge boulder into a calm lake, stirring up thousands of waves. In the court hall, the voices of opposition rose and fell one after another, one wave higher than the other. Those conservative officials, like a cat whose tail was stepped on, jumped up and down and tried their best to obstruct the implementation of the New Deal.
Although the empress was strong, she felt somewhat powerless in the face of such intricate interest groups. She can kill a prince and depose a few corrupt officials, but she cannot replace the entire court of officials. If pushed too hastily, it may cause greater turmoil.
For several days, the empress seemed a little worried and her brows were furrowed. Qin Ye saw it and was anxious in his heart. He knew that the Empress's new policy was a rare opportunity for the Great Yan Empire. If you miss it, you may never get another chance.
That evening, Qin Ye took the initiative to ask to see the empress. In the imperial study room, he saw the empress sitting behind a desk with piles of memorials in front of her. However, she did not review them. She just stared blankly out of the window, not knowing what she was thinking.
"I'd like to see you, Your Majesty." Qin Ye walked to the desk and bowed in salute.
The empress came back to her senses and saw him, with a tired smile on her face: "Qin Aiqing, you are here. Sit down."
Qin Ye sat down as he was told, looking at the empress' face that was obviously much thinner, feeling a little uncomfortable in his heart. He pondered for a moment, and then slowly said: "Your Majesty, I am brave enough to offer you a plan for Your Majesty."
"Oh?" A glint of interest flashed in the empress's eyes, "Qin Aiqing, what good ideas do you have? Tell me quickly!"
Qin Ye stood up, walked to the map of the Great Yan Empire hanging on the wall, pointed to several important states and counties marked on the map, and said slowly: "Your Majesty, I believe that the biggest resistance to Your Majesty's desire to implement the New Deal does not come from those conservative officials, but from...the interest groups they represent behind them!"
Hearing this, the empress nodded thoughtfully: "What Qin Aiqing said is absolutely true. The reason why those officials desperately opposed my new deal is simply because the new deal harmed the interests of the wealthy families and wealthy businessmen behind them!"
"Exactly!" Qin Ye continued, "So, if Your Majesty wants to implement the New Deal, you must first break the monopoly of these interest groups! And to break their monopoly, you need... to support new forces!"
"New power?" The empress raised an eyebrow, "What does Qin Aiqing mean...?"
Qin Ye's eyes became profound, and he said slowly: "Wei Chen refers to... a scholar from a poor family!"
"A gentleman from a poor family?" A trace of doubt flashed in the empress's eyes.
"That's right!" Qin Ye nodded, "Nowadays, most of the officials in the court come from aristocratic families. They have been officials for generations and are intertwined, forming an unbreakable community of interests. However, although the scholars from poor families are talented, they have difficulty entering the court and displaying their ambitions because they have no background and connections!"
He paused and his voice became more powerful: "If Your Majesty can break the rules and vigorously promote those scholars from poor families with real talents and knowledge, let them enter the court and form a check and balance with those children from aristocratic families! In this way, the power of those conservatives will naturally be weakened! And His Majesty's New Deal will also be supported by more people!"
After listening to Qin Ye's words, the empress' eyes suddenly lit up! She seemed to see a bright light in the darkness!
"Brilliant plan! It really is a brilliant plan!" The empress couldn't help but exclaim, "Qin Aiqing, this plan of yours has simply cleared the air and made me enlightened!"
She stood up and paced back and forth in the royal study. As she walked, she said excitedly: "I can open an 'Enke' and expand the admission quota, specifically for those poor scholars! I can also set up a 'Seek for Talents' to recruit talents from all over the world! I want those wealthy families to know that this world is not just for their family!"
Qin Ye felt relieved as he looked at the empress's newly glowing face. He knew that his strategy had touched the heart of the empress.
"Your Majesty, your Majesty!" Qin Ye bowed and said, "However, I have some suggestions."
"Qin Aiqing just says it's okay!" the empress said quickly.
Qin Ye said slowly: "It is certainly a good thing for Your Majesty to promote scholars from poor families. But you must also be careful to proceed step by step and not act too hastily. Otherwise, I am afraid it will cause a fierce backlash from those wealthy families. Wei Chen suggested that you can start with some less sensitive positions and gradually cultivate the strength of the poor people. At the same time, you must also strengthen the inspection and training of those promoted from poor families to ensure that they are truly talented, moral, and qualified for their positions."
After hearing this, the empress nodded repeatedly: "Qin Aiqing is very thoughtful! I will do as you say!"
Qin Ye offered suggestions to stabilize the situation. When the empress's implementation of the new policy encountered huge resistance, Qin Ye made a timely offer - to support poor families and break the monopoly of aristocratic families! This policy, like a key, opened the shackles in the Empress' heart and pointed out a new path for the future of the Great Yan Empire!
